title: Maximum Area of Two Non-Overlapping Square Submatrices
summary: Choose two cell-disjoint all-one square submatrices of the same side length. Return the largest possible area of each square, not their combined area. Return zero if two nonempty qualifying squares cannot be chosen.
officialConstraints: Binary matrix with1..500 rows and columns.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
